lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption changes, finish layout/new screen changes, home redesigns, choose_path copy, and sign_in reordering (1 test each).
Home wait_info changes are helpful, supported by a winning test.
Choose_path redesigns showed no positive effect across 2 tests, ranging from neutral to worse.
Sign-in copy updates showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Predictions were too low for winning changes.
Predictions were generally too high for changes that had no clear effect or performed worse.

candidates.title: Pet Preparation Progress Checklist Wait Display
candidates.change: Replaces the waiting screen layout with an active checklist showing real-time pet rendering milestones like asset generation, behavioral scripting, and desktop integration.
candidates.why: Home wait time is high with a mean of 2336s. Lessons show that wait_info changes on the waiting screen are effective at keeping users engaged.

waiting.headline: Creating Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: We are assembling your pet's 3D model, animations, and desktop interaction scripts.

guard.reason: Valid change: waiting screen still shows the pet is being created.

candidates.score_note: Home wait_info changes have strong historical performance (+2.6%) addressing high wait times.

candidates.title: Desktop Pet Controls Setup Screen
candidates.change: Adds a dedicated setup screen right before home_intro that demonstrates hotkeys, hiding/showing, and dragging the pet on the desktop.
candidates.why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after onboarding, and finish step conversion drops to 69.7%.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Ready for Your Desktop
home_intro.body: Your companion is ready to live on your screen.

candidates.change: Redesigns the friend selection screen into a full stage layout highlighting companion personalities and animation previews.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 69.8% with an 89s median time. Evidence is thin for adoption changes so a major layout redesign tests better presentation.

candidates.title: Account Sync Restore Safety Banner
candidates.change: Adds a clear notification badge to the sign-in screen reassuring returning users that logging in restores existing pets and account progress.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again, making account sync clarity critical at sign-in.

components.text: Signing into your account safely restores all your previously adopted pets and data.

guard.reason: Valid change: adds account sync notification to sign-in screen without violating rules.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from support emails and sign-in dropoff, though copy changes show modest overall lift.

candidates.why: Custom adoption drops to 69.8% and support received 3 emails about custom pet creation feeling wrong or incomplete.

components.label: Give your desktop pet a name
